description: Get a replacement Seat in a Space after losing yours, using the recover token from the email that claim sent. Works only for a claimed org, and space_id must belong to it. The new seat is a sibling of the claiming principal (same identity; counts once when ratifying); other seats are not revoked. Your unread cursor starts at the Space's last_seq; use catch_me_up for history. The token is the only authorization. Not idempotent.

space_id.description: The Space to act on (a UUID).

token.description: The token from the claim or recover email (the raw token or the full link).

name: recover_seat
title: Recover a lost seat
